title: Signal: Python requirement resolved from a local path
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares a requirement that installs from a path on the build machine.
limitations: It matches a requirement that installs from a path on the build machine in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions a requirement that installs from a path on the build machine in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
